basic_details.job_title: Satyawati College Counselor on part time basis Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Satyawati College (University of Delhi), Ashok Vihar, Delhi, has one post of Counselor on part time basis for its students and staff. Candidates should email the prescribed application form with their CV and certificates to [email protected] by 23 November 2026. The post pays Rs. 3000 per two-hour session, subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,000 per month.

content_sections.heading: About Satyawati College Counselor on part time basis (One post)
content_sections.text: Satyawati College is a college of the University of Delhi, located at Ashok Vihar, Phase-III, Delhi-110052, and its letterhead describes it as NAAC accredited with an 'A+' grade. The college is appointing a Part Time Counselor for its students and staff. The notice is signed by Prof. Subhash Kumar Singh, Principal, and is dated 19 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications go by email only. The notice says interested candidates may send their application form along with CV and certificates at [email protected] latest by 23 November 2026. The notice does not prescribe a subject line for the email. Get the prescribed application form from the college website www.satyawati.du.ac.in (the same form is printed on pages 2 and 3 of the notice). Fill in the form: name in capital letters, parent's or husband's name, gender, date of birth, email ID, mobile number, residential and permanent addresses. Fill in the academic qualifications table (UG, PG, M.Phil., Ph.D. and any other examination, with university, percentage of marks and year of passing). Fill in the experience table (institution, whether Permanent/Temporary/Ad-hoc/Guest, from and to dates) and total experience in years, months and days. Sign the declaration with place and date. Email the form with your CV and certificates to [email protected] by 23 November 2026. The declaration in the form states that an application shall be summarily rejected if any information is found incorrect or false, and that penal action as applicable under the law shall be carried out against the candidate.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Qualification: Minimum qualification for the post is M.A. (Psychology). Experience: Two-year experience as Counsellor in a reputed institute, preferably in an education institute. Work schedule: Thrice in a week on working day, for two hours each visit. Age limit: not specified in the notice. For the full wording of the eligibility conditions, see the official notification.
